purpose: select configurations on robot development videos, then freeze and reproduce from scratch
held_out_caveat: Existing reporting subset has already been inspected diagnostically; do not describe it as never-seen blind test. Do not use it for hyperparameter or checkpoint selection.
selection_scope: same full videos and query sets; no per-method clipping or selection
gate_note: Practical development gate fixed before development inference results, not statistical significance or paper acceptance.
iteration: Each change uses a new versioned configuration/output directory; never edit an active run's model code or rewrite its metrics.
scratch_reproduction: New empty output directories; rebuild geometric caches from verified source videos, initialize and train head anew, rerun development then reporting evaluation. Do not copy cached model predictions or trained head into the reproduction.
reproduction_limit: Asynchronous wall-clock scheduling can change evidence availability; measure repeated-run variation rather than promise bitwise identity.
training_rule: Current Kubric train supervision is permitted; all algorithm selection and final validation use robot videos. Development labels are never promoted to final test evidence.
